messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick sync — customer AcME wants a 6-week POC for multi-turn summarization + retrieval. They're asking for scope, success criteria, pricing, and what SE/eng support we need. Can we confirm resourcing?

Maria (SE): @Alex thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) production dataset size & PII? 2) preferred hosting mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)? 3) latency SLOs and QPS target? 4) key eval metrics (ROUGE/F1/human eval)?

Alex (Sales): Answers: dataset ~50k docs (mostly internal product specs, some PII), prefer Dedicated if possible, target 100 qps peak, p95 latency <300ms for short summaries. Eval: relevance + factuality; they want automated eval + 10 human evals per week.

Maria (SE): OK. PII + Dedicated => need PO to enable private VPC or dedicated capacity. Security questionnaire will be heavy. Suggest scoping: week0 onboarding & infra, week1 data ingest + privacy review, week2 prompts + baseline eval, week3 model tuning + caching, week4 perf testing + SLO tuning, week5 user acceptance + handover. Success criteria: automated eval pass thresholds: relevance >=0.75, hallucination rate <5%, p95 latency <350ms under 50 qps. Also require no high-severity security gaps.

Jin (Eng): From runtime perspective, to hit p95 <350ms at 50 qps we need: 2 x A100 nodes in Dedicated pool (or 4 x A10G with optimized batching), KV cache enabled, quantized model (int8). SE support: 0.4 FTE first 3 weeks for prompt/eval harness + 0.2 FTE for weeks 4-6. Eng infra: 0.5 FTE week0-2 for onboarding + 0.2 FTE week3-5 for perf tuning. Can we get signoff on these FTEs?

Sam (PM): Pricing note: POC baseline estimate: Dedicated reserve + SE support ~= $35k for 6 weeks (includes 2 A100-week equivalents, SE hours). If they go to Dedicated contract, we'll credit POC fees. We should include clause: security questionnaire turnaround 5 business days.

Maria (SE): For evals we'll need prompt set of ~200 queries reflecting their flows, plus 10 red-team cases for hallucination. Can Alex ask customer for a 1-week sample or sandbox export? Also need data transfer SLA for private data.

Alex (Sales): I'll request the sample and ask legal for the DPA. I'll also flag the customer that SE time is limited — they must commit to weekly triage calls. I'll confirm by EOD.

SecurityBot: Automated check: Dedicated plan requires SOC2 + penetration test or shared ATO. Docs: https://redwood.ai/security/dedicated

Jin (Eng): If security requires pen test, that adds 2 weeks to timeline. Should we mark that as risk #1?

Maria (SE): Yes. Risk register: 1) Pen test => +2w, 2) Data export delays => +1-2w, 3) Model quality regressions => require rollback plan. Proposed accept criteria and milestone deliverables in short:
- Week0 (kickoff): NDA, DPA, infra access
- Week1: data ingest + baseline runs (deliverable: baseline eval report)
- Week2-3: prompt tuning + evals (deliverable: tuned prompt pack + eval matrix)
- Week4: perf run + SLO report
- Week5: UAT + handover doc

Alex (Sales): Sounds good. Approvals needed: Sales manager signoff on estimated POC cost, legal DPA, infra provisioning ticket. I'll loop in @Nina (Sales Manager) and @Legal.

Sam (PM): I'll add these milestones to the POC template and assign owners. Also will make a compact one-pager for the customer.

Alex (Sales): Thanks all. I'll update thread after I hear from customer.

Maria (SE): :thumbsup:
